template.coordinate_system: PDF user space, origin bottom-left, units points
template.visual_strategy: Original PDF pages are preserved as the page background. Transparent, borderless AcroForm text widgets are layered above the original blanks.
template.appearance_strategy: Blank widget appearance streams and default backgrounds are removed. Filling software must regenerate appearances and should flatten final PDFs.

generation_contract.boolean_strategy: Boolean cells are controlled one-character text fields. Populate X for true and empty string for false.
generation_contract.signature_strategy: Typed signatures may populate the signature text fields. Image signatures should be placed into the same rect_pdf coordinates and the final PDF flattened.
generation_contract.totals_strategy: Totals are application-calculated and fields are marked read-only. Populate through the PDF engine after calculating from structured data.
finalization_steps: Embed or use one pinned approved font.
Place signature images using mapped signature rectangles when applicable.
Validate page count, dimensions, text presence, and visual golden comparison.
Store the result as an immutable document version.
generation_contract.printed_default_value_rule: For these fields, preserve the untouched template appearance when blank. When a calculated value is populated, use the mapped field rectangle as an opaque white knockout, then draw the new centered value and flatten.
